statement.zh: 比布鲁斯等海岸城市语境中的早期字母铭文传统，是腓尼基文化史的核心议题（Markoe；UNESCO Byblos）。
statement.en: Early alphabetic inscription traditions in coastal cities such as Byblos are a core theme of Phoenician cultural history (Markoe; UNESCO Byblos).
